For more information, please see axaxl.com/sustainability.Who we areAXA XL, the P&C and specialty risk division of AXA, is known for solving complex risks. By combining a comprehensive and efficient capital platform, data-driven insights, leading technology, and the best talent in an agile and inclusive workspace, empowered to deliver top client service across all our lines of business − property, casualty, professional, financial lines and specialty.With an innovative and flexible approach to risk solutions, we partner with those who move the world forward.Learn more at axaxl.com

title: Customer Success Director
description:
About The RoleAs Customer Success Director, you’ll be a senior member of the team in EMEA, owning a portfolio of our most strategic enterprise customers, across publishers, broadcasters and audio businesses activating advertising across web, app, audio and CTV. You’ll be fully accountable for the commercial health of your book, owning renewals, upsell and cross-sell, and measured on Gross Retention and Net Dollar Retention. You’ll also be an example to the rest of the team, setting best practice for customer relationship management and acting as a mentor for the team..What You’ll Be DoingAs Customer Success Director, you’ll deepen our strategic relationships with top tier customers in the UK and Europe, most of which have a global presence. You’ll drive continuous improvements in customer health, help customers advance their first party audience strategies, enable collaboration with advertiser partners, and guide them in leveraging first-party data to unlock new revenue opportunities.Great CSDs here connect the dots. You’ll understand the value of each product use case and link it to others, driving holistic adoption of Permutive rather than a single product. You’ll know what each customer needs to achieve over the year, build the sequential plan to get them there, and take them on that journey. Your goal should be to continuously identify ways to evolve their strategy and lead a creative process to unlock additional pockets of value for them, deeply solidifying our position as their strategic, long-term partner.About The TeamYou’ll be joining a collaborative, diverse customer success team based in London, Berlin, Paris and across the United States. We’re focused on ensuring our customers meet their organisations’ strategic goals while helping us achieve world-class customer satisfaction and net revenue retention. We’re a forward thinking team who cares deeply about our customers’ businesses; we’re industry experts and consultants. We’re the voice, eyes and ears of our customers at Permutive, and we work hard to spread customer empathy across every internal team.Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:Achieving and maintaining high customer health through strategic success and account planning and engagements (e.g. Executive Business Reviews), understanding and improving product usage, and supporting customers in meeting their business objectivesManaging a book of business, comprised of our top tier, strategic customers in the UK, a good number of which run global businesses; deeply understanding their commercial strategy, needs, and pain points; proactively bringing those insights back to the businessYour book of business will consist of enterprise customers who have been our strategic partners for a number of years; you will be expected to proactively identify ways to advance their first party audience strategy and unlock additional pockets of value for them on a regular basis, further solidifying our position as their strategic partner. You will proactively support your customers in building and optimising their direct-sold advertising business, and help them go to market through 1-1 and at-scale enablement tacticsStaying close to the product: running strong discovery so every demo is relevant, articulating value clearly, and connecting use cases across direct and programmatic to drive holistic adoptionMulti threading across the customer’s organisation, from day-to-day executional stakeholders to C-suite (e.g. CROs, VPs of RevOps), confidently setting and running economic buyer meetings yourselfRunning rigorous renewal qualification using frameworks such as MEDDPICC, proactively surfacing risk early and building plans to de risk accounts and secure multi year commitmentsPartnering with teams across the business to deliver value for customers, and acting as the voice of the customer by bringing product and strategy feedback back to PermutiveStaying ahead of evolving trends in digital advertising, data, identity and privacy, and sharing that knowledge with customers and the teamWhat you’ll need?You’ll be perfect for this role if you have:You’ve worked as a Senior Customer Success Manager, CS Director or Account Manager within a SaaS organisation, ideally in ad tech space but we’re open to martech or data (e.g. data platforms or cloud data businesses)You have significant experience managing enterprise, strategic accounts with a white-glove service model, navigating large contracts and complex organisationsYou have strong commercial acumen and a proven track record of owning renewals and expansion, with experience using qualification frameworks such as MEDDPICCYou have a strong track record of driving best-in-class net revenue retention, including examples of turning around at risk accounts into upsell or cross sellYou’re comfortable building relationships with C-suite and executive stakeholders and mapping complex organisations across geographies and budget holdersYou’ve created and delivered frameworks for value delivery, tracked them, and built compelling narratives against them (e.g. in EBRs)You have a deep understanding of the advertising and media landscapeYou’re confident working with data to draw conclusions and take action, and you actively use AI tools (such as Claude) to work smarter and drive things forwardYou’re genuinely curious and keen to learn the industry, comfortable with ambiguity, and have thrived in a scale-up where things aren’t always 100% clear. Where content or collateral doesn’t exist, you’ll create it and share it with the teamWe’ll Be Excited If You Also Have…Direct experience managing customer relationships with global publishers, broadcasters or audio businessesFamiliarity with CTV and identity solutionsFluency in Italian, Spanish (nice to have). What We Are OfferingWe take a structured, objective approach to salary-setting, which is based on market information, our compensation strategy, and your experience and capability assessed through our interview process. For a typical candidate who meets our requirements, we pay a base salary between £80,000 - £100,000 with a 20% performance bonus.BenefitsIn this together: As a full-time employee, you'll become a shareholder with stock options, sharing in our collective success. Family Comes First: Primary caregivers receive up to 6 months of fully paid leave and secondary caregivers receive 3 months of fully paid leave to bond with their little ones. Your Time, Your Way: Flexible hours let you fit work around your life, whether it's hitting the gym, meditating, or handling family needs. Upgraded Workspace: A £350 budget helps you create the perfect home office setup. Recharge & Refocus: Unlimited paid time off (with a minimum of 25 days + public holidays) ensures you get the rest you need. Grow with Us: Ongoing training and development opportunities fuel your career aspirations. Mental Health Matters: We prioritise your well-being with free access to Spill, our mental health partner. Comprehensive Care: Private Medical and dental cover, plus virtual GP appointments, work-life consultations so you and your health are looked after. Secure your future: Our pension plan with Penfold helps you secure your financial future (employer contributes 3%, employee contributes 5%). Work Your WayPermutive trusts you to manage your time and deliver results. Our hybrid model allows you to choose where you work best, whether in your own productive space or our London (Farringdon) or New York (Union Square) offices. That said, none of us work alone; we are part of a team.To foster collaboration and connection, teams in these locations come together in person at least once a week and are encouraged to benefit from being in our offices to meet with teams more often. Commercial and customer-facing teams are encouraged to embrace in-person interactions to build lasting relationships with clients and colleagues.Every Permutive employee gets together in person at the company’s Annual Kick Off for a week in February. Each year’s event promises to be an exciting opportunity for us to come together, reconnect with colleagues, and align on our shared vision for the year ahead.Diversity, Equity & InclusionAt Permutive, we’re taking a thoughtful, intersectional, long-term approach to diversity, equity & inclusion. We care deeply about creating an inclusive work environment that allows everyone to flourish, and we are taking continual action to progress in that direction.We’re committed to hiring people regardless of race, religion, colour, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, age, neurodiversity status, disability status, or otherwise.

UK based (London)About The RoleAs a Client Development Manager, you will be the trusted partner our clients turn to in your market. As a scale-up, we want you to bring your ideas, help shape our regional strategy and take the initiative to act on them.Key ResponsibilitiesClient partnershipsBe the key point of contact for your clients and “big bet” accounts, with Europe GM support on the largest.Move clients from first project to long-term partnership, contributing to their learning plans and business objectives.Lead client meetings, presentations and renewals, and gather feedback regularly.Research designUnderstand the business question behind each brief.Design the right approach across qual and quant.Write clear proposals and RFP responses, with Research Director input on methodology.Regional strategy and growthBring ideas proactively and take the initiative to make them happen.Open doors with new brands, supported by a Sales Operations Executive for prospecting.Represent Bolt Insight at industry events.Track progress against regional growth targets.Global accounts and collaborationShare leads, learnings and best practice across the European team.Work with other regions to grow global accounts and give clients one joined-up Bolt Insight experience.Bring local market knowledge into global account plans.Delivery alignmentWork with the research team to keep projects on brief, ground findings in business reality and make outputs actionable. This role has no direct delivery.Be the voice of the client internally.Feed market learnings back to product and strategy teams.RequirementsMinimum 5-6+ years in research or insights, client or agency side.Solid grasp of either qualitative or quantitative methods.Able to design research proposals from a client brief.Interest in client partnerships and growing a market.Confident presenting to senior stakeholders, in person and on video.Strong drive and bias to action: you bring ideas unprompted and make things happen.Why Work for Bolt Insight?Bolt Insight Is a B2B SaaS Consumer Research Platform Serving Global FMCG/CPG Brands And Agencies. With The Bolt 2.0 Relaunch, We Are Building a Suite-based Platform Across Research, Simulation And Analytics, Powered By Bolt IQ, Our AI Layer. We’re a Vibrant And Growing Start-up Mentality Business With a Passionate Team That Thrives On Innovation And Collaboration. Here’s What You Can Expect When You Join UsRemote working and the flexibility to work in a nomadic way – Enjoy the best of both worlds, balancing work and life your way.Flexible working environment – We trust you to manage your time and work in a way that suits you best.Private Medical Insurance - Your health and well-being are important to us, and we’ve got you covered.Virtual or local team gatherings – Whether online or in person, we love to connect and celebrate our successes together.In-house recognition awards – We celebrate our ‘lightning bolts’ (those who go above and beyond) and show our appreciation for hard work!At Bolt, curiosity, creativity and passion matter most. If you’re excited about shaping the future of research and contributing to a culture built on innovation and collaboration, we’d love to hear from you.Bolt Insight is an equal opportunities employer committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive, diverse and professional workplace for all. We strive to create a welcoming environment where all individuals, no matter their background or identity, feel valued and supported.If you have specific requirements throughout the recruitment process, please reach out to a member of our HR team who will make the appropriate adjustments.Apply today and join a dynamic, international team driving innovation across borders!

title: Senior Account Manager
description:
Job DescriptionJob Description: Senior Account Strategy ManagerLocation: London (preferred), with other locations consideredHours: Monday-Friday 9–5:30HybridAbout The RoleCSC is seeking a proactive and commercially minded Senior Account Strategy Manager to strengthen strategic account development across its Global Financial Services (GFS) business, supporting the development and growth of key client relationships.This role will play a key part in CSC’s account management capability, ensuring coordinated engagement across account teams and driving consistent execution of account growth plans. Working closely with sales, commercial leaders and senior stakeholders across the business, the Senior Account Strategy Manager will bring structure and momentum to and translate strategic account priorities into clear actions, maintain momentum and ensure opportunities for growth are identified and progressed.The successful candidate will combine commercial judgement, strong organizational and relationship management skills, enabling them to coordinate activity across complex and diverse account teams, maintain visibility of key relationships and opportunities, and ensure stakeholders remain aligned on priorities and next steps.This is an opportunity to play a central role in supporting CSC’s growth ambitions by improving account coordination, strengthening client relationships and driving greater focus on priority accounts.Key Responsibilities:Strategic Account Development Set objectives and coordinate activity across priority accounts, ensuring alignment between account teams, business leaders and internal stakeholders.  Contribute to the development of CSC’s account-based strategy, helping translate strategic priorities into clear account-level objectives and actions.  Work closely with account leads to identify opportunities to strengthen client engagement, deepen relationships and expand CSC’s presence within priority accounts. Account Planning and Execution Facilitate and manage the development, maintenance and execution of strategic account plans.  Track progress against account plans and follow up with stakeholders to ensure agreed actions are completed.  Organise and coordinate account planning sessions, ensuring clear outcomes and next steps.  Help maintain momentum across account teams, proactively identifying delays, gaps or barriers to progress and working with stakeholders to address them.  Promote the consistent application of account management best practice. Stakeholder and Relationship Management Build and maintain strong working relationships with stakeholders across CSC, facilitating collaboration between account teams and supporting functions, and ensuring relevant stakeholders have visibility of account developments.  Help map key client and internal relationships, identifying decision-makers, influencers and opportunities to strengthen engagement.  Work with account leads to coordinate client engagement and ensure CSC presents a joined-up, consistent approach to strategic accounts. Opportunity Management and Account Intelligence Maintain account intelligence and up-to-date visibility of opportunities, relationship development and account activity.  Track the account pipeline and growth initiatives, helping identify opportunities for cross-selling, upselling and expanding CSC’s services within existing clients.  Interpret relevant market, client and competitor intelligence to drive account development and commercial decision-making.  Produce regular account updates and reporting. Account Development and Continuous Improvement: Drive forward account plans by maintaining momentum on agreed account priorities and ensuring consistent follow-through.  Proactively identify opportunities to improve account coordination, stakeholder engagement and the effectiveness of account planning processes.  Support the sharing of successful approaches and best practices across CSC. Skills And Experience Experience in strategic account development, client relationship management, business development, sales operations or a similar commercial role, ideally within financial services, professional services, legal or technology.  Strong organisational and coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple accounts, priorities and workstreams simultaneously.  Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and functions.  Strong commercial awareness and the ability to identify opportunities to grow existing client relationships.  Excellent communication skills, with the ability to consolidate and share information.  Strong analytical and reporting capabilities.  A proactive, structured and delivery-focused approach, with strong attention to detail and a willingness to take ownership.  Confidence in engaging stakeholders at different levels of seniority and influencing progress. Key Success Measures: Effective development of account strategy and execution across CSC’s priority accounts.  Improved completion of account plan actions and achievement of agreed milestones.  Increased visibility of account opportunities, pipeline development and relationship coverage.  Stronger collaboration and alignment between account teams and internal stakeholders.  Sustained momentum in executing strategic account growth plans.  Identification and progression of cross-selling, upselling and broader account expansion opportunities.  Improved consistency, quality and effectiveness of account planning and reporting. The Ideal Candidate: The ideal candidate is a commercially astute, highly organised account management professional who excels at bringing people together, maintaining focus, developing strategy then turning it into action.  They will be comfortable working across multiple strategic accounts, building relationships with stakeholders at all levels and ensuring that important opportunities and actions do not lose momentum. They will combine a proactive, hands-on approach with strong commercial awareness, helping account teams focus on the right priorities while providing the coordination, structure and insight needed to accelerate growth.  Above all, they will be motivated by the opportunity to help CSC deepen its relationships with key clients, maximise the potential of its highest-priority accounts and deliver sustainable growth. About UsCSC is a global business, legal, and financial services company based in Wilmington, Delaware, USA, providing knowledge-based solutions to clients worldwide. We have offices and capabilities in over 140 jurisdictions in the Americas, Europe, Asia Pacific, and the Middle East, and more than 8,000 colleagues. We are the business behind business.®Visit our careers site to learn more about CSC and our commitment to our clients, communities, and each other.CSC is committed to creating a feeling of belonging through a diverse and growth-oriented environment where everyone is valued.CSC colleagues have global career opportunities and excellent benefits, including annual success-sharing bonuses or commission plans based on individual performance. To learn more, visit cscglobal.com/service/careers .We offer a range of support to colleagues with disabilities, ensuring people have the necessary resources to thrive in their roles. We encourage candidates to work closely with our talent acquisition partners to convey their specific needs. Our commitment to accessibility reflects our broader dedication to diversity and belonging,CSC only accepts resumes from employment agencies that are part of our approved supplier program. Resumes submitted from other agencies either to talent acquisition, our hiring leaders, employees, or through any other mechanism other than our supplier process, will not be eligible to claim related fees and the submitted resumes will be considered property of CSC.We encourage candidates to apply directly to our website and not through third-party sources.Disclaimer: The information above describes the general nature and level of work performed by employees in this role. It is not intended to describe all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications.About The TeamAt CSC®, we’re always looking ahead, finding ways to innovate, challenge the status quo, and anticipate the needs of our clients. We exceed expectations by adapting client ambitions and goals as our own. This Fierce Client Spirit has helped us adapt and create solutions that have enabled businesses to run smoother and smarter for more than 125 years. It’s also the reason we’re the trusted partner of many of the world’s most successful organizations.CSC is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining talented people whose values align with ours. We empower our colleagues to bring the right solutions to market to meet client demand. That’s why we are the leading provider of business administration and compliance solutions.CSC is a great place to work with smart and dedicated people. We have won several employer recognition awards, including Top Workplace USA, Great Places to Work India, and Built In’s Best Places to Work. We offer fulfilling work and career opportunities. Most positions are filled with internal moves and employee referrals. Employees are eligible for Success Sharing, bonuses, or commission plans based on role and individual performance. CSC offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package that includes annual leave, tuition reimbursement, referral bonuses, and more. As business needs allow, CSC offers hybrid or remote work schedules in alignment with local regulations. Specific details for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Digital Delivery Manager
description:
Job SummaryThe Office for National Statistics (ONS) is the UK’s largest producer of official statistics, covering a range of key economic, social, and demographic topics. These include measuring changes in the value of the UK economy, estimating the size, geographic distribution, and characteristics of the population, and providing indicators of price inflation, employment, earnings, crime, and migration.This role is within the Advanced Data Formats Service in Digital Publishing, which aims to support users to find, understand, explore and use ONS data. We look after and improve the services that make data available through the ONS website, downloads, interactive tools and APIs, while developing better ways for people and machines to access trusted statistics. Our work brings together data, technology and user needs, replacing older services with simpler, more joined-up ways to publish and use ONS data.Job DescriptionA delivery manager will build and maintain teams, ensuring they are motivated, collaborating and working well. The complexity or breadth of products or teams will vary in this role, depending on the context.They Also:Identify obstacles and help the team to overcome them.Focus the team on what is most important to the delivery of products and services. You Can:Making the process work (Expert):Identify and challenge organisational processes of increasing complexity and those processes that are unnecessarily complicated.Add value and can coach the organisation to inspect and adapt processes.Understand external suppliers’ delivery approaches and adapt to ensure interface to ONS delivery approach is smooth, challenging external supplier to align more closely where appropriate.Guide teams through the implementation of a new process. Life cycle management (Working)You Can:manage the delivery of products and services that add value through different phases of the life cycle, with some supportidentify if the product or service should move to the next phase and, if it should, how to do thisensure the product or service is developed in line with the appropriate service standards for a phaseuse new information to adapt approaches to life cycle managementBehavioursWe'll assess you against these behaviours during the selection process:Changing and ImprovingDelivering at PaceWorking TogetherCommunicating and InfluencingBenefitsAlongside your salary of £43,329, Office for National Statistics contributes £12,552 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme.  Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides (opens in a new window).The Office for National Statistics is part of the Civil Service, and as such we share a number of key benefits with other departments, whilst also having our own unique offerings to support our valued colleagues across the organisation.Whether you are hearing about us for the first time or already know a bit about our organisation, we hope that our careers site will give you a great insight into the benefits and facilities available to our colleagues, and our fantastic working culture. Inclusion & AccessibilityAt ONS we are always looking to attract the very best people from the widest possible talent pool, and we are proud to be an inclusive, equal opportunities employer. As a Disability Confident Leader we’re committed to ensuring that all candidates are treated fairly throughout the recruitment process.As part of our application process, you will be prompted to provide details of any reasonable adjustments to our recruitment process that you need. If you are currently in the UK on a time-limited visa, it must have at least 18 months remaining at the point of application.Right To Work And Nationality RequirementsTo work at ONS, applicants must meet the Civil Service nationality requirements, satisfy UK right to work requirements and, where applicable, meet the relevant security clearance requirements.If you are unsure whether you meet the appropriate right to work or security clearance eligibility criteria, please refer to the guidance on Gov.uk or contact the recruitment email provided in the advert before applying. title: Product Manager
description:
As a trusted partner, our Public Health mission is to make food systems safer, healthier and more sustainable. Throughout our global network in 27 countries, we offer to our customers a wide range of testing and innovative solutions dedicated to preventing health risks related to food, environment and consumer goods. External growth has been a key pillar of our history with more than 40 acquisitions completed in the last 10 years.If you want to contribute to an inspiring long-term purpose, to be part of a fast growing company on a high-value market with significant build-up opportunities, and to grow in an entrepreneurial and warm environment, join us! Northern Europe Cluster Industry Product Manager We are looking for a Northern Europe Cluster Industry Product Manager to support and grow the industry portfolio across the Pharma Quality Control and Food Safety & Quality markets. This role sits at the intersection of science, marketing and business strategy, transforming market insights into commercial actions that drive portfolio growth and customer value across the Northern Europe Cluster.Working closely with local commercial teams, regional stakeholders and global product management teams, the Industry Product Manager will support portfolio performance, market development and customer engagement activities. The role requires a balance of scientific knowledge, commercial awareness and strategic thinking, enabling informed decisions around product positioning, pricing, lifecycle management and business opportunities.Reporting into the Northern Europe Cluster Marketing organisation, the Industry Product Manager will collaborate extensively across Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, Application Specialists and Global Product Management teams. This is a field-based role with regular travel across the Northern Europe Cluster and France, providing direct exposure to customers, laboratories, industry events and key stakeholders.What will your responsibilities be?  Manage the Industry portfolio throughout the product lifecycle, from launch and market introduction through to phase-out and end-of-life activities.  Monitor portfolio performance, identifying growth opportunities and supporting actions to improve business results and market penetration.  Support pricing strategy development and pricing policy recommendations, ensuring alignment with commercial objectives and market conditions.  Contribute to portfolio positioning, value proposition development and deployment of strategic marketing initiatives across the region.  Gather, analyse and interpret market, competitive, customer and regulatory intelligence to support business decisions and commercial strategy.  Monitor industry trends, customer needs and competitor activities, identifying opportunities and risks impacting portfolio performance.  Provide market insights and recommendations to marketing and commercial teams to support business planning and growth initiatives.  Support annual budgeting, forecasting and business review processes, contributing to performance analysis and demand planning activities.  Partner with commercial teams to provide product expertise, technical support and tactical guidance during customer engagements.  Participate in customer visits, laboratory visits and strategic account discussions to better understand market needs and strengthen customer relationships.  Gather customer feedback and communicate market requirements to regional and global product management teams.  Build relationships with industry influencers, key opinion leaders and strategic stakeholders across the pharmaceutical and food sectors.  Support the development and execution of the Marketing Action Plan, ensuring alignment with regional and global objectives.  Contribute to the creation of customer-facing materials, product training content and promotional activities.  Plan, organise and participate in congresses, exhibitions, demonstrations, workshops and user meetings to support awareness and demand generation.  Collaborate effectively across local, regional and global functions to ensure successful execution of portfolio and marketing initiatives. Who are you?  Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Microbiology, Molecular Biology, Biomedical Science or a related scientific discipline.
